summary.text: Dawn Addis represents California's coastal 30th Assembly District, which includes large portions of San Luis Obispo, Monterey and Santa Cruz Counties. She was elected to the Assembly in 2022 and reelected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: She taught special education in public schools for over 20 years and served on the Morro Bay City Council from 2018 to 2022.
Her official biography lists a bachelor's degree in art education and Spanish and a master's degree in special education from San Francisco State University.
